prompt_protocol: five NExT-GQA options; gold A-E logprob minus best foil
primary_estimand: mean[(full margin - evidence-mask margin) - (full margin - matched-control-mask margin)] among baseline-correct samples
control_protocol: same number of black-masked frames; non-grounding indices chosen to minimize temporal rank-distance from evidence indices

multiplicity: One predeclared primary cohort (baseline-correct); all-sample, baseline-incorrect, and interaction results are secondary and not multiplicity-corrected.
signflip_test: Two-sided sample-level random sign flips of the mean contrast; assumes symmetric paired null effects.
limitations: Black-frame masking is an out-of-distribution perturbation; equal-dose control reduces but does not remove this concern.
The gold-vs-best-foil letter margin is prompt-dependent and is not official free-generation accuracy.
Conditioning on baseline correctness is part of the prespecified primary cohort; this does not establish general XAI faithfulness or head causality.
